## Purpose
The app's error display: `ErrorState`, a red card with the API error message and an optional Retry button, and `InlineError`, a single line.

## Responsibilities
- **`ErrorState({error, onRetry, className, title="Something went wrong"})`:** an AlertTriangle icon, the title, `errorMessage(error)`, and, when `onRetry` is given, an outline "Retry" button with a RefreshCw icon.
- **`InlineError({error, className})`:** `text-xs text-red` with the message.

## Key elements
`ErrorState`, `InlineError`.

## Control flow
None.

## Data, state and side effects
None.

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- **Uses:** `api/client.errorMessage` and the ui Button.
- **Used by:** the pages when a query fails.

## Error handling and edge cases
- Handles any error shape through `errorMessage`.
